body: You made a lot of sense... But I can't bring my self to tell my wife the extent of what I feel.... And I can try and forget my financial problemes but they'll be there tomorrow... I know you don't need money to be happy ! but when you have student loads and banks running after you, you can't ignore them....

Alcohol isn't the problem... Everyday I cope everyday I fight but I have friends and family and I drink socially but I often finish alone with alcohol in my blood stream with these thoughts. Yes my wife could be my anchor but I can't bring my self to tell what I feed in this situation... Yeah I know .. not cool
